# SkillOffice departments

<!-- Generated by "skilloffice build" from registry/departments.yaml and each catalog.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

SkillOffice has 18 departments ready to install. Each one has a manager that plans the work, runs only the skills a request needs, fixes problems once and writes one report.

Install a department with its code, for example: `skilloffice install --platform claude-code --departments fin,legal`. See [Getting started](getting-started.md).

| Code | Department | What it covers | Skills |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

<a id="shared-productivity"></a>

## Shared Productivity

Install code: `sp` · Manager skill: `sp-manager` · Status: Built and tested on Claude Code; second platform pending

Meeting notes, emails, documents, research briefs, task planning, summaries, presentation outlines, translation and writing review, used by every department

Not covered here: General-purpose helpers only; department-specific work belongs to that department

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sp-document-drafting` | Drafts memos, one-pagers, internal announcements, FAQs and how-to notes, outline first, with missing facts marked. |
| `sp-email-draft` | Drafts routine work emails and replies in the brand voice with gaps marked; never sends, routes specialist emails to departments. |
| `sp-meeting-notes` | Turns raw notes or transcripts into clean minutes with decisions, owned and unowned action items, and open questions. |
| `sp-presentation-outline` | Builds a slide-by-slide outline with assertion titles, evidence needed and speaker notes, sized to the time available. |
| `sp-research-brief` | Plans a research question and writes a brief where every claim cites a source, confidence is stated and conflicts are shown. |
| `sp-summarize` | Summarizes material at the requested length, keeping numbers, names, dates and caveats exactly and adding nothing. |
| `sp-task-planning` | Turns goals and commitments into a prioritized task list with flags; writes a TASKS.md file only when the user asks. |
| `sp-translate-localize` | Translates and localizes business text to the output language with local formats; flags regulated text for human review. |
| `sp-writing-review` | Reviews everyday writing for clarity, structure, tone, plain and inclusive language and accessibility; returns findings. |

## Finance and Accounting

Journal entries, reconciliations, month-end close, financial statements, variance analysis, cash-flow forecasts, invoicing and collections drafts, audit preparation and tax document organizing

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |

| `fin-financial-statements` | Drafts income statement, balance sheet and cash flow from closed books, with comparisons, tie-out checks and material variances. |
| `fin-invoicing-collections` | Drafts tone-matched receivables reminders and checks, codes and matches payables with a proposed payment run; never sends or pays. |
| `fin-journal-entries` | Drafts balanced journal entries with calculation support, source references and reversal flags for human review; never posts. |

| `fin-reconciliation` | Reviews bank, subledger, settlement and intercompany reconciliations; categorizes and ages reconciling items; reports findings. |
| `fin-tax-prep-organizer` | Organizes a tax-season pack for the adviser from closed books; checklist, payee review, gaps and questions; no advice, no filing. |
| `fin-variance-analysis` | Decomposes material variances into drivers that reconcile exactly, with narratives; reports unexplained variances as findings. |

<a id="legal-risk-compliance"></a>

## Legal, Risk and Compliance

Install code: `legal` · Manager skill: `legal-manager` · Status: Built and tested on Claude Code; second platform pending

Contract and NDA review, vendor terms, compliance checks, risk registers, privacy reviews (GDPR, DPDP, CCPA and more), policy drafting, legal response drafts and matter briefs

Not covered here: Security controls go to Cybersecurity; this department covers legal and regulatory meaning

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `legal-compliance-check` | Screens a planned action for applicable laws, standards and policies; marks requirements met, not met or unknown; lists approvals; tracks audit readiness. |
| `legal-contract-review` | Clause-by-clause contract review from the user's side: green, yellow and red issues, business impact and draft redlines for counsel. |
| `legal-matter-brief` | Plain-English brief of a legal matter or meeting for executives: status, risks, decisions needed, gaps, and action items with owners. |
| `legal-nda-triage` | Screens an NDA and classifies it green, yellow or red with quoted findings and suggested fixes; recommends a route, never approves. |
| `legal-policy-drafting` | Drafts or updates policies and public notices in plain English for counsel review, with facts relied on and CONFIRM and COUNSEL markers. |
| `legal-privacy-review` | Reviews personal data handling against privacy themes for the stated jurisdictions: inventory, basis, notice, retention, transfers, rights, breach readiness. |
| `legal-response-draft` | Drafts replies to legal inquiries after an escalation check; demand letters, legal process and regulators always go to counsel. Never sends. |
| `legal-risk-assessment` | Scores legal and operational risks with a 5 by 5 matrix, maintains a risk register with owners and reviews, and recommends escalation. |
| `legal-vendor-terms-check` | Consolidated view of a vendor's agreements from provided documents: status, key terms, renewal dates, survivals and gaps such as a missing DPA. |

| `sls-deal-review` | Reviews one deal for health, stage reality and gaps to close as findings; drafts a business case and mutual action plan on request. |

| `sls-win-loss-review` | Finds win and loss patterns in a closed-deals export with sample sizes, coded reasons and recommended actions. |

<a id="software-development"></a>

## Software Development and Engineering

Install code: `dev` · Manager skill: `dev-manager` · Status: Built and tested on Claude Code; second platform pending

Requirements, system design, implementation plans, test-driven development, debugging, code review, documentation, tech debt and verification

Not covered here: Test strategy goes to QA; infrastructure and deployment go to DevOps; security audits go to Cybersecurity

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `dev-code-review` | Reviews code changes for correctness, security, performance, maintainability and tests, and handles received review feedback with rigor. |
| `dev-documentation` | Writes and updates READMEs, API references, runbooks, architecture documents and onboarding guides for their real readers. |
| `dev-implementation-plan` | Writes a test-first, task-by-task implementation plan from an approved design, then executes it with a progress record and recorded rulings. |
| `dev-requirements-brainstorm` | Turns a software request into an approved written design, with a chosen approach, before any code is written. |
| `dev-system-design` | Designs systems, APIs and data models, records architecture decisions (ADRs) and evaluates design proposals with explicit trade-offs. |
| `dev-systematic-debugging` | Finds the root cause of bugs and failures through evidence before any fix, then fixes it with a regression test. |
| `dev-tech-debt` | Identifies, categorizes and prioritizes technical debt with evidence and a phased remediation plan that fits alongside feature work. |
| `dev-test-driven-development` | Enforces red-green-refactor: write a failing test, watch it fail, write minimal code, run the whole suite, then refactor. |
| `dev-verification` | Runs fresh checks (tests, lint, build, requirements checklist) and reports actual results before any claim that work is done. |

<a id="quality-assurance"></a>

## Quality Assurance and Testing

Install code: `qa` · Manager skill: `qa-manager` · Status: Built and tested on Claude Code; second platform pending

Test strategy and plans, test case design, exploratory, web UI and API testing, regression suite review, bug reports and release verification (software)

Not covered here: Manufacturing quality control belongs to Supply Chain (later)

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `qa-api-testing` | Tests HTTP APIs against their contract: status codes, validation, auth and authorization, pagination, errors and idempotency, in test environments only. |
| `qa-bug-report` | Writes reproducible bug reports with minimal steps, expected vs actual, separate severity and priority, and redacted evidence; triages duplicates. |
| `qa-exploratory-testing` | Plans and runs time-boxed exploratory sessions from risk-based charters using heuristics, and records notes, bugs and questions. |
| `qa-regression-review` | Reviews a test suite for coverage gaps, flaky patterns, brittle selectors, weak assertions, slow tests and unsafe test data. Read-only, findings. |
| `qa-release-verification` | Checks release readiness from fresh evidence on the release build and recommends go, go with conditions or no-go. Never cached; never approves. |
| `qa-test-case-design` | Designs traced test cases with partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions and pairwise, with steps, data and expected results. |
| `qa-test-plan` | Writes a test plan: scope in and out, approach per area, environments, roles, placeholder schedule, risks, criteria and deliverables. |
| `qa-test-strategy` | Designs a risk-based test strategy: test levels per risk, what to automate, environments, test data, and entry and exit criteria. |
| `qa-web-ui-testing` | Tests a local web app in a real browser: discovers elements, drives user journeys, asserts visible results, captures screenshots and console errors. |

| `ops-deploy-verification` | Go or no-go deploy recommendation from fresh evidence, with rollback triggers and a post-deploy plan; never cached, never deploys. |
| `ops-incident-response` | Guides live incidents (severity, roles, evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, updates, timeline) and writes runbooks and on-call handoffs. |
| `ops-infrastructure-as-code` | Writes and reviews infrastructure as code: modules, state, tagging, pinned providers, plan review and cloud choices; never applies. |
| `ops-kubernetes` | Writes and reviews Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, security policies and GitOps layouts; validates with dry runs, never applies. |
| `ops-observability` | Designs metrics, symptom-based alerts, dashboards, structured logs and OpenTelemetry tracing for services and infrastructure. |
| `ops-postmortem` | Writes blameless postmortems: timeline, impact, causes and contributing factors, lessons and owned action items. |
| `ops-secrets-management` | Designs secret storage, injection, rotation, scanning and leak response; works with secret names only, never values. |
| `ops-slo` | Defines SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with burn-rate alerts, an error budget policy and a dashboard; SLAs stay a business decision. |

More detail: [13-devops-sre README](../departments/13-devops-sre/README.md)

<a id="cybersecurity"></a>

## Cybersecurity

Install code: `sec` · Manager skill: `sec-manager` · Status: Built and tested on Claude Code; second platform pending

Threat modeling, secure code review, security requirements and mitigations, SAST setup, dependency and secrets reviews, security policies and incident triage (defensive only)

Not covered here: Regulatory interpretation goes to Legal

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sec-dependency-review` | Read-only supply-chain review of manifests, lockfiles and audit output: vulnerabilities, pinning, package health, imitation risks, licenses. |
| `sec-incident-triage` | First response to a suspected security incident: record, assess, preserve evidence, recommend containment, scope, notification questions for legal. |
| `sec-sast-setup` | Plans and configures SAST: tool choice, baseline, staged blocking, tuning, custom rules and CI integration. Writes config only after approval. |
| `sec-secrets-exposure-review` | Read-only search for hardcoded and exposed secrets in the user's code and config, with masked evidence, rotation advice and secret-management review. |
| `sec-secure-code-review` | Read-only security review of code: input-to-sink tracing, auth, injection, XSS, SSRF, files, sessions, secrets and config, with evidence and fixes. |
| `sec-security-policy` | Drafts and reviews practical security policies sized to the company, with owners and review cadence. Not legal advice; compliance items go to legal. |
| `sec-security-requirements` | Turns threats, specs and obligations into specific, testable, traced security requirements and security user stories. |
| `sec-threat-mitigation` | Maps threats to preventive, detective and corrective controls, finds gaps and builds a prioritized now, next, later remediation plan. |
| `sec-threat-model` | Evidence-based threat model: system model, trust boundaries, assets, STRIDE threats, abuse paths and attack trees, prioritized mitigations. |

<a id="data-analytics-ai"></a>

## Data, Analytics and AI

Install code: `data` · Manager skill: `data-manager` · Status: Built and tested on Claude Code; second platform pending

Data exploration, SQL, analysis, visualization, dashboards, data validation, data storytelling, data dictionaries and AI feature reviews

Not covered here: Application code around models goes to Software Development

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `data-ai-feature-review` | Reviews an AI or LLM feature for data privacy, manipulated inputs, evaluation, wrong answers, human oversight, cost and lock-in; returns findings. |
| `data-analysis` | Answers business questions from user-provided data with sound statistics, stated assumptions, sample sizes, uncertainty and reproducible steps. |
| `data-dashboard-design` | Designs decision-focused KPI dashboards with defined metrics, layout and refresh plan, and can build a self-contained HTML dashboard from user data. |
| `data-dictionary` | Documents entities, tables, metric definitions, standard filters and gotchas into a data dictionary file through interviews and schema exports. |
| `data-explore` | Profiles a user-provided dataset for grain, column types, quality issues and recommended dimensions, metrics and follow-up analyses. |
| `data-sql` | Writes read-only, dialect-aware SQL from a data question, with assumptions, performance notes and checks; the user runs the query. |
| `data-storytelling` | Turns provided analysis results into an honest, audience-specific narrative with one message, evidence, caveats and a specific ask. |
| `data-validation` | Reviews an analysis, query, chart, dataset or pipeline for correctness and data quality; returns findings and a ready, caveats or revise verdict. |
| `data-visualization` | Picks the right chart for a message and builds it honestly and accessibly from user data, with an insight title, alt text and data table. |
